props.gloss_en: Shmuel: a person may do all his needs with bread
Shmuel's dictum accords with R' Eliezer
R' Yosei b. R' Chanina: the Sages agree with R' Eliezer about the cup of blessing, that one does not bless over it until water is put in it
Rav Oshaya: [the reason is that] we require a mitzva [done] in the choicest manner
the Sages: either way [even before water was put in it] one says 'Who creates fruit of the vine' over [the wine]
R' Zeira: it [undiluted wine] is fit for kuryatei
one does not put raw meat on bread
one does not pass a full cup over bread
one does not throw bread
one does not prop up a dish with bread
[dates and pomegranates being served,] Mar Zutra took and threw [some] before Rav Ashi
the baraita Rav Ashi cites: one does not throw foods
Mar Zutra: that [baraita] was taught of bread
the baraita of Rav Ashi's והתניא: just as one does not throw bread, so one does not throw foods
the baraita of Mar Zutra's והתניא: although one does not throw bread, one does throw foods
this [the baraita forbidding throwing foods] is of a thing that becomes repulsive
that [the baraita permitting throwing foods] is of a thing that does not become repulsive
one draws wine through pipes before a groom and before a bride
and one throws roasted grain and nuts before them in the summer
but not in the rainy season
but not cakes, neither in the summer nor in the rainy season

objections.gloss_en: לא סבר לה מר להא דתניא אין זורקין את האוכלין? -- does the master not hold the baraita: one does not throw foods?

answered_by.gloss_en: ההיא בפת תניא -- that was taught of bread (= p_mz_hahi_bepat). UNDERCUT: Rav Ashi's והתניא attacks this reading (obj_keshem_ein_zorkin) and the stam's אלא abandons it at 50b.11

objections.gloss_en: והתניא: כשם שאין זורקין את הפת, כך אין זורקין את האוכלין! -- a baraita forbids throwing foods as well as bread
